2122652720788349419.en_summary: BREAKING: Hackers spread malware to websites run by at least 178 major organizations, including Zoom, CNN, BBC, Fox News, HSBC, Equifax, Salesforce, IKEA and Air France-KLM, per security firm Report URI. Attackers exploited a flaw in Optimizely, a website-testing platform, to plant code designed to steal payment data, hijack crypto payments and target older iPhones. Banking and finance was hit hardest, with 32 organizations affected, including HSBC across multiple markets. Optimizely says the flaw is fixed. Report URI has traced about $7,000 in stolen crypto so far.
2122652720788349419.zh_summary: 突發：駭客向至少178家主要組織運營的網站傳播惡意軟件，包括Zoom、CNN、BBC、Fox News、HSBC、Equifax、Salesforce、IKEA和Air France-KLM，據安全公司Report URI。攻擊者利用網站測試平台Optimizely的漏洞植入旨在竊取支付數據、劫持加密支付並針對較舊 iPhone的代碼。銀行和金融受創最重，32家組織受影響，包括多個市場的HSBC。Optimizely表示漏洞已修復。Report URI目前追蹤到約7000美元被盜加密貨幣。
